services.name: Microscopic Root Canal Treatment (Painless Single Sitting)

knowledgeBase.question: What is microscopic dental care and why is it better?
knowledgeBase.answer: Dr. Prem uses advanced Carl Zeiss surgical dental microscopes providing 20x magnification. This ensures 100% precision, preserving maximum natural tooth structure with completely pain-free root canals and restorations.

knowledgeBase.question: Where is the clinic located and is there parking?
knowledgeBase.answer: We are located in Indiranagar, Bangalore with dedicated patient valet parking available in front of the clinic.

knowledgeBase.question: Are you open on Sundays or late evenings?
knowledgeBase.answer: Yes! Dr. Prem is available Monday to Saturday until 7:30 PM, and on Sundays from 10:00 AM to 1:30 PM for working professionals and families.

knowledgeBase.question: Do you accept health insurance or EMI for treatments?
knowledgeBase.answer: Yes, we support all major cashless health insurance claim documentation and offer 0% interest monthly EMI options for root canals, braces, and implants.
